verdict.rationale: Zep says it builds a Context Graph from documents as well as chat and business data, and that graph is searchable through hybrid semantic plus BM25 search (zep-docs-27, zep-probe-1, zep-docs-9). However, the documented ingestible data types are only JSON, text, and message (zep-docs-2). That implies developers must extract text from PDFs and other files themselves, and there is no evidence of image support at all. Missing for 10: native PDF/file upload or parsing, image or multimodal ingestion, documentation of document-ingestion workflows, independent corroboration.
